# ChatConfig

> **File:** `config/ChatConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the Chat section. API keys are not config: see SecretsManager.

### Properties

- `providers` (readonly var): Chat.providers, each with an `id` (from its name when left empty) and a `defaultModel` (the first model when left empty)
- `savedProviders` (readonly var): Chat.providers as saved (no filled-in ids or names), for editing
- `presets` (readonly var)
- `defaultProvider` (readonly string)
- `defaultPreset` (readonly string)
- `maxTokens` (readonly int)
- `keepConversations` (readonly int): 0: conversations aren't saved
- `showThinking` (readonly bool)
- `renderMarkdown` (readonly bool)
- `sendKey` (readonly string): "enter" | "ctrlEnter"

### Functions

- `provider(id)`: A provider by id: the default, else the first, for an unknown one
- `preset(name)`: A preset by name (the default, else the first, for an unknown one); never null, so a config without presets still chats
